info.name: MyResume API
info.description:
Local Spring Boot API for resume management with JWT auth.

Start the API:
  cd myresumeapi
  ./mvnw spring-boot:run

Default base URL: http://localhost:8080

Suggested flow:
  1. Health Check
  2. Login (or Register) — saves accessToken automatically
  3. Create Resume — saves resumeId
  4. Update Resume — PUT with resumeId + userId
  5. Get Resume By Id / Get Resumes By User

request.description: Returns OK when the API is running. No authentication required.
Creates a new user and returns a JWT. On success, saves accessToken and userId to collection variables for all Resume requests.
Authenticates a user and returns a JWT. On success, saves accessToken to collection variables — all Resume requests use it automatically.
Returns all users. Requires a valid JWT (run Login or Register first).

exec: console.warn('No accessToken set. Run Auth > Login first.');
